gaps.next_text: For as long as we could remember, the cosmos was quiet . . . peaceful . . .

gaps.prev_text: Until, one shattering day, we heard the death cry of a galaxy.
gaps.next_text: It was then we understood our purpose: to heal and bring peace. . .

cues.text: In the deep, silent expanse of space, a vast starfield twinkles against swirling dark blue and emerald nebulae.
A distant galaxy bursts into bright light.
Rushing into a bright pink and purple nebula.
A sleek, dark spacecraft drifts through the gloom.
Inside the cockpit, a robotic sensor hangs in front of an octagonal window. Red holographic data flickers on the glass.
A pilot in an armored spacesuit sits at the controls, her face visible through a clear visor.
The shadowy cloud, bearing two glowing red eyes, rushes toward the ship.
Purple smoke swallows the pilot, plunging everything into darkness. Moments later, her face emerges from the shadows, her right eye glowing a piercing purple.
She sits calmly. A dark fleet gathers.
A purple electronic pattern crawls across her cheek. She smiles faintly before everything fades to black.

The colors shift to bright pinks and purples while rushing forward into a nebula.
A sleek, dark spacecraft with swept-back wings drifts through dark space.
Inside the cockpit, a robotic sensor hangs from the ceiling in front of an octagonal window. Red holographic data flickers.
A pilot in a bulky, armored spacesuit sits at the controls. Her face is visible through a clear visor.

Outside view of the dark spacecraft.

The shadowy cloud rushes rapidly toward the ship.
Purple smoke seeps into the cockpit, engulfing the pilot.
Complete darkness.
The pilot's face emerges from the darkness, her right eye glowing bright purple.
The ship drifts in space.
The pilot sits calmly at the controls, bathed in red light.
A fleet of dark spacecraft flies in formation.
